pre_final_permission_gate.nonterminal_required_behavior: Execute the runtime-required next action, stale-adoption recovery, strategy switch or parent-state recomputation instead of rendering a final response.

final_response_definition: Every assistant message emitted on the final channel while an Enterprise Math RESEARCHER or RESEARCH_DRIVER role is active, after the canonical runtime has permitted final output. Short status answers, readiness/completion receipts, handoffs, blocked/no-go conclusions, refusals, and ordinary substantive research answers are all included once final permission exists.
non_final_exemption: commentary/progress/tool-call messages do not require the footer because they are not final responses
researcher_scope_resolution: if an explicit task_id is active, use that exact task_id
role_transition: The footer template changes immediately with the active role while preserving the current execution identity according to research_identity_state_machine.json.
forbidden: rendering the final channel while research_runtime_state_machine final_allowed is false
omitting the marker because the final response is short
showing the marker only on the first or last research return
using Researcher-ID for an active RESEARCH_DRIVER role
using Driver-ID for an active RESEARCHER role
using DIRECT as the visible researcher scope
duplicating the marker in one final response
suppressing the marker because identity registration is pending
